h:
下载 svg 图像并将其粘贴到您的 comfyui 上。 SVG 包含所有节点和工作流程。

简单易用的字幕生成。只需将目录粘贴到图像文件夹并点击运行即可。有一个选项可以选择您想要在 comfyui 默认情况下运行工作流程的次数。将数量更改为总图像数并点击运行。
如果您想在提示中包含标签，只需选择prompt_gen_mix_caption

o.en:
Download the image svg and paste it onto your comfyui. the SVG contains all the nodes and workflow.

simple easy to use caption generation. Just paste the directory to your image folder and hit run. There is an option to select how many times you want to run the workflow in comfyui default. change the number to total images and hit run.
IF you want to include tag in the prompt, Simply choose prompt_gen_mix_caption
